The '''northern cave''' was a cavern on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. During the [[Third Galactic War|new galactic conflict]] between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the cave was secretly used by Imperial emissaries to make dealings with the [[Untamed]].
